verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is an API-first product. Its core function is described as transcription 'through an API', and the web tool is framed as a way to 'test-drive the API'. Documented endpoints cover the transcription workflow: job creation by URL or upload, every option (diarization, language, segment length, confidence filtering, redaction), status and result retrieval in JSON/SRT/VTT, SSE streaming, webhooks, and auth and health checks. A published OpenAPI spec backs this up. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that account, billing and API-key management are available via API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
